amendment_run_a01.amendment_reason: Remove HFT/arbitrage framing, replace vacuum tunnel with 1km SMF-28 fiber, remove 14.8 ps erroneous collision, reassign Test 42 to 1999.6kg tungsten support load (19.61 kN -> <=0.08 kN), register Test 14 prediction debt (11-14% vs 141 ps), controlled quench, ordinary inertial response with 1 kJ damper dissipation, twelve nodes as architecture hypothesis only.

scenes.title: [Scene 1: The Man Who Owns Delay]
scenes.focus: Supply chain map and industrial capacity reservation; three latencies (physics, control, industrial); reversible loss vs irreversible delay.

scenes.title: [Scene 2: Apocalypse and Latency]
scenes.focus: Reversible manufacturing option reservation; no twelve-node construction contract.

scenes.title: [Scene 1: The Sealed Kilometer]
scenes.focus: Sealed, thermally controlled 1 km commercial SMF-28 optical fiber system wound on mandrel; independent optical bench and timing chains.

scenes.title: [Scene 2: The Phase Fold]
scenes.focus: Reversible field-correlated delay reduction (~60 ps validated, ~12.3 mm equivalent optical length); no physical contraction or superluminal claims.

scenes.title: [Scene 1: Test Fourteen]
scenes.focus: Frozen quantitative prediction (11-14% increase) vs ~141 ps observed (~19.5%); controlled quench with localized conductor damage (SCIENCE_DEBT_ACT2_TEST14_PREDICTION_001).

scenes.title: [Scene 2: The Current-Sharing Boundary]
scenes.focus: Current-sharing boundary (전류 분배 한계) in superconducting architecture; Mark II CICC redesign.

scenes.title: [Scene 3: Test Forty-Two]
scenes.focus: Support-load reduction for 1999.6 kg tungsten test mass (19.61 kN baseline to <=0.08 kN); 14.8 ps removed; no direct gravitational mass claims.

scenes.title: [Scene 1: The Weightless Block]
scenes.focus: Support-decoupled mass: ordinary inertial response (F/a ≈ 2000 kg) maintained despite >99% support-load reduction; no equivalence-principle violation.

scenes.title: [Scene 2: The Mass That Remained]
scenes.focus: Controlled boundary exit; ~1 kJ mechanical dissipation through hydraulic/crush cradle; no unresolved energy/momentum discontinuity.

scenes.title: [Scene 3: Twelve Nodes]
scenes.focus: Twelve nodes as architecture hypothesis only (12 = engineering minimum for study); physical G-DCL commissioning is Act 4 (FUTURE_CAPABILITY_DEBT_ACT2_TWELVE_NODES_001).
